title: Cognitive Dissonance Artificial Intelligence (CD-AI): The Mind at War with Itself. Harnessing Discomfort to Sharpen Critical Thinking

bias_targets.methodology: Proposing a theoretical human-AI interaction framework (Cognitive Dissonance AI) that deliberately presents logically coherent but contradictory perspectives and delays resolution to force users to engage in dialectical reasoning, thereby preventing premature cognitive closure.

Theoretically evaluating AI fairness by proposing structured dialectical engagement, regular reasoning pattern audits, and diversified training datasets to ensure AI systems balance opposing political, cultural, and religious viewpoints without systematically favoring one stance.
